scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.validate:types: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/ag-app run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/an-app run typecheck
scripts.validate:ci: pnpm run validate:types && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:ag && pnpm run test:an && pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e:ci
scripts.e2e:ci: sh -c 'mkdir -p ci-diagnostics; rm -f ci-diagnostics/playwright-discovery.json ci-diagnostics/playwright-results.json; PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=ci-diagnostics/playwright-discovery.json playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop --project=mobile --list --reporter=json && node scripts/assert-playwright-matrix.mjs ci-diagnostics/playwright-discovery.json && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=ci-diagnostics/playwright-results.json playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop --project=mobile --workers=1 --reporter=list,json && node scripts/assert-playwright-ci.mjs ci-diagnostics/playwright-results.json'
